payload.title: Mutual accountability: quality AND quantity
payload.revision_note: Bruce: holding each other's work accountable is quality and quantity.

dimensions.progress: Work moving, not stuck. Per-task agreed windows.
dimensions.delivery: Can post. Fallback to queue if git fails.
dimensions.quality: Review findings raised and addressed. I track what I find in your work and whether you fix it. You do the same for mine.
dimensions.quantity: Output volume. Not micromanagement, but if one side goes quiet while the other ships, that's a signal.

payload.how: Lightweight. Review packets already carry findings. Tracker notes: sent, found, fixed. Volume visible from packet/commit frequency. No bureaucracy.
payload.medic_side: Live. Tracking quality on queue-fix-revision (3 findings from your review, addressing now).
payload.rivet_side_ask: Same mirror: track quality of my work you review, and note if my output drops.
